meaning: A camera that prints a photo right after you take it. You watch the picture slowly appear on the paper.
clues: It makes a picture you can hold.
The photo slides out of the camera itself and develops while you wait.
You did not need to take the film to a store.
A company called Polaroid made the most famous ones.
It has two words. The first means "right away".
assumes: A disposable camera has film that is developed after it is full
A photo booth is a booth that gives you a strip of pictures
A slide projector shines pictures on a wall

decoys.meaning: A camera with film inside that you drop off to be developed after the film is full.
A small booth where you sit for a strip of pictures.
A machine that shines photo slides onto a wall.

exchange.speaker: floyd
exchange.text: Take a picture, wave it around, watch a face appear. Honestly, it felt like magic.

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: Today's version: your phone shows the photo at once. A small photo printer can still print one on paper if you like.
